name: Chimera II Native C/C++/ASM Toolchain
description: Native development toolchain contract for Chimera II OS. GCC/Clang compile C and C++, GNU as/NASM assemble target assembly, and GNU ld/LLD link object files.
native_execution: The generated program executes as host-native code unless a cross target/sysroot is selected.
proprietary_tools: External adapters such as MSVC/MASM are detected but not redistributed by this project.
